title: Computable Countermarkets and the Limits of Universal Trading
abstract: arXiv:2604.13334v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We explain why no trading algorithm can guarantee profit in every market. For each deterministic program that always returns a finite-precision position, we construct a fixed, algorithmically generated price path on which every active position loses and inactivity earns nothing. This holds with positive, continually changing prices, costless trading, and unlimited computation time. Separate arguments limit learning market rules, certifying future events, and establishing randomness from finite data. Useful strategies may exploit market structure, information, or compensation for risk, while benchmark performance need not imply profit. Reversing and rearranging price histories within the assumed market class provide practical stress tests, distinguishing conditional success from universal guarantees.

translated_title: 可计算反市场与普适交易的极限
translated_abstract: 我们解释了为什么没有任何交易算法能够在所有市场中保证盈利。对于每个总是返回有限精度头寸的确定性程序，我们构造了一条固定的、由算法生成的价格路径，在该路径上每个活跃头寸都会亏损，而无所作为则一无所获。这一结论在价格为正且不断变化、交易零成本、计算时间不受限制的条件下依然成立。另有独立论证表明，从有限数据中学习市场规则、认证未来事件以及建立随机性均受到限制。有用的策略可能利用市场结构、信息或风险补偿，而基准表现并不必然意味着盈利。在所假设的市场类别内反转和重排价格历史，可以提供实用的压力测试方法，从而区分条件性成功与普适性保证。
tldr: 本文通过为任意确定性交易程序构造一条算法生成的对抗性价格路径，证明不存在能在所有市场中保证盈利的交易算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that no trading algorithm can guarantee profit in every market by constructing, for any deterministic trading program, an adversarial algorithmically-generated price path on which every active position loses.
